name: manual_afc087
claim: Quote env file values that may contain a dollar sign: an unquoted value with dollar characters is expanded by the shell, so the variable silently becomes empty or mangled in every shell that sources the file; and reference one working key by alias from another file instead of keeping a second copy of a dead key.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26 audit: the restored GLM52 key line is unquoted with dollar characters and was empty in fresh shells; two dead keys were replaced by references to the working Gemini and GitHub keys, verified identical by hash.

rationale: 2026-11-26 audit: the restored GLM52 key line is unquoted with dollar characters and was empty in fresh shells; two dead keys were replaced by references to the working Gemini and GitHub keys, verified identical by hash.
